shortDescription: Apple Inc. said a small number of AT&T Inc. customers who recently upgraded to the iPhone 18 Pro Max will need replacement devices after a bug caused them to lose cellular service, according to Bloomberg.

title: Apple Says Some AT&T iPhone 18 Pro Max Users Need Device Replacements
